name: Mencshely (Hungary)
description: Green field with a yellow triangle descending from the top edge to a point at the bottom centre, charged in the triangle with the municipal arms of Mencshely (a blue shield with two yellow lions holding a sword) below a scroll inscribed MENCSHELY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: inverted triangle from the top edge
